title: Thornwick
summary: Thornwick Market & Frontier Garrison: Behind weathered timber ramparts and soot-blackened bastions, border merchants, veteran quartermasters, and tavern chronic
infobox: Warden Hale, Reeve Marlow, Edda the Miller, Ford-Scout Bren, Orlen the Grave-Tender, Master Hobb, Widow Marta, Sergeant-at-Arms Garrick, Old Fenwick

p: Thornwick Market & Frontier Garrison: Behind weathered timber ramparts and soot-blackened bastions, border merchants, veteran quartermasters, and tavern chroniclers gather. Resupply provisions, hire hardened sellswords, inscribe newly found spell scrolls at the academy, and consult the garrison quest board between bloody expeditions into the frontier.

The Border Fords Wardens: Remnants of Thornwick's provincial levy and bridge-pickets who held the Alder River crossings after the Salt Tithe stripped their armories. Stubborn, mud-stained pragmatists who value dry powder, honest weight, and unbroken watch-rotations above noble titles.

list: Master Hobb (Smith): If it's bent, I'll hammer it flat. If the man inside it is dead, take him to the ditch first.
Widow Marta (Alchemist): Don't touch the green bottles unless you want your teeth to come loose by supper.
Sergeant-at-Arms Garrick (Captain): Sign your mark on the roll or get off the parade ground. I'm short forty pikes and two lieutenants.
Old Fenwick (Ferryman): Two copper to cross alive, one copper if I just have to fish your boots out of the weir.

title: Redmarsh Outpost
summary: Redmarsh Encampment: A fortified outpost erected upon the drying salt flats and sun-bleached ribcages of the deep mire. Desert caravans trade hardened scale arm
infobox: Quartermaster Bram, Water-Seller Tull, Chronicler Zahra, Sabik the Sand-Walker, Miner Tomas, Cask-Master Tull

p: Redmarsh Encampment: A fortified outpost erected upon the drying salt flats and sun-bleached ribcages of the deep mire. Desert caravans trade hardened scale armor, ancient dune charms, and water flasks. Re-equip your troops and recruit desert scouts accustomed to the furnace winds.

list: Quartermaster Bram (Fence): Water is four silver a gill, shade is two silver an hour, and complaints are free but ignored.
Chronicler Zahra (Scholar): Please wipe the alkali mud from your greaves before stepping on the rubbings; this inscription is older than your language.
Cask-Master Tull (Innkeeper): Don't ask where the well is. Just ask whether I boiled it before or after I fished the scorpion out.

title: Oakhaven Harbor
summary: Oakhaven Coastal Frontier: Perched beneath towering ironwood groves overlooking the Western Sea, where Bailiff Aldric, Ward-Scholar Elowen, Master-at-Arms Toren
infobox: Kors the Shipwright, Surgeon Sera, Warden Lyra, Harbor-Master Tavin, Sage Quillon, Chief Healer Sera, Iron-Wright Kors, Gate Warden Lyra, Mudlark Pip

p: Oakhaven Coastal Frontier: Perched beneath towering ironwood groves overlooking the Western Sea, where Bailiff Aldric, Ward-Scholar Elowen, Master-at-Arms Toren, and Chief Healer Sera marshal refugees and armor caravels for the great evacuation.

list: Chief Healer Sera (Priest): If you can walk into my tent, you aren't dying fast enough to skip the queue. Sit on the crate.
Iron-Wright Kors (Smith): Armor's just a hull for a man's guts. Keep the seams caulked and the bilge dry, and you'll stay afloat.
Gate Warden Lyra (Captain): Wind's twelve knots from the sou'west. Aim two fingers left of the breastplate if you want to hit the throat.
Mudlark Pip (Child): Found a dead knight at low tide, mister! Couldn't get his boots off 'cause his feet were still in 'em, but I got his ring!

title: Ironcamp Forge-Hold
summary: Highcrest Citadel: Carved into the razor granite spine dividing the coast from the Obsidian Caldera, where Marshal Vance, Harbor Marshal Veyra, Weaponsmith Elda
infobox: Forgemaster Vok, Brother Elias, Commander Rowan, Sir Aldren, Centurion Draven, Captain Rowan, Brother Elias the Scorched

p: Highcrest Citadel: Carved into the razor granite spine dividing the coast from the Obsidian Caldera, where Marshal Vance, Harbor Marshal Veyra, Weaponsmith Elda, and Archivist Orla prepare the rearguard's final march.

list: Captain Rowan (Captain): Don't salute out here. The sniper-fiends on the obsidian ridge look for anyone stupid enough to raise an arm.
Forgemaster Vok (Smith): No coal needed here. Just stick the billet in the floor-crack and pull it out before the rock eats it.
Brother Elias the Scorched (Alchemist): I cannot see your heraldry, friend, only the heat of your blood and the weight of the iron you carry.
